purpose: Certify that every bounded Stage1 compiler storage lane on the exact final canonical source and exact Stage1 artifact has native no-truncation evidence. Historical projections or partial candidate reports cannot satisfy this contract.

lane_shape.required: integer >= 0; exact native high-water requirement for this canonical compile
lane_shape.capacity: integer >= 0; physical capacity available in the final Stage1 artifact
lane_shape.max_written_index: null only when required=0; otherwise integer required-1 or lower when sparse storage is explicitly declared
lane_shape.sparse: boolean; if false max_written_index must equal required-1
lane_shape.overflow_attempted: boolean, must be false for canonical compile
lane_shape.guard_probe: PASS; qualification test must separately prove an out-of-range write fails closed
lane_shape.dispatch_proof: PASS for banked lane, NOT_BANKED for single lane
lane_shape.roundtrip_proof: PASS for banked lane, NOT_BANKED for single lane
lane_shape.provenance: non-empty description of the native counter/write frontier

fail_closed_if: bounded write-site count differs from accounted write-site count
a lane has required > capacity or negative headroom
a lane reports truncation or overflow on the canonical compile
a lane lacks an exercised fail-closed overflow guard
a banked lane lacks exhaustive dispatch and roundtrip proof
canonical source SHA/bytes differ from the source file supplied to the finalizer
Stage1 artifact SHA/bytes differ from the executable supplied to the finalizer
platform is not native Linux x86-64

output_qualification.all_capacities_no_truncation: PASS only when every rule above passes
